## [I absolutely loved the Akara rug from…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a72918b554b39ae580955d3)
I absolutely loved the Akara rug from Lulu and Georgia. The rug is stylish,soft, and beautiful. I bought it as a bath mat. I did not need to wash it for a long period of time. After the first wash in cold water as directed, the colors ran and it is now unuseable. I reached out to customer service who stated it was past the return time, despite the fact that first wash as directed destroyed the product. They offered 20% off another item. Extremely disappointed .

July 31, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 5, 2026

We're so sorry to hear about your experience with the Akara rug. We understand how disappointing it must have been for the rug to become unusable after following the care instructions.

We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback, as it helps us continue to improve both our products and our customer experience. Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.
